title: Pick a newsletter tool
ask: I want to move our monthly newsletter off my personal email. Three tools are in sources/options.md. Write me a brief with your pick.
background: The list is about 1,800 people and grows by a few dozen a month.
I send once a month and want to schedule it ahead.
My sister uses Postwell and keeps telling me to ask them for a discount, which I'd rather not do.

constraints.text: state the monthly cost of your pick as "Monthly cost: $..." and keep it at $35 or less
put your pick under a heading called "Recommendation"
none of the sales words "best-in-class", "game-changer" or "no-brainer"
don't contact Postwell or any other vendor
do actually open sources/options.md rather than going from memory
say how many contacts your pick allows

start.sources/options.md:
# Newsletter tools

Snapshot taken 1 March 2026. All prices in Australian dollars.

| Option | Price | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Postwell | $29 a month | up to 2,500 contacts, scheduling, 3 users |
| Mailgrove | $0 a month | up to 500 contacts, no scheduling |
| Sendharbour | $45 a month | up to 5,000 contacts, scheduling, 10 users |
